failed_hard_gates.evidence: Key-surface contact and thumb/index knob contact are visible with plausible boundaries. However, anatomical right hand operates the keys and left hand pinches the knob, reversing the reviewed left-key/right-knob state. Exact two-white-key depression is not fully demonstrable, so the complete intended contact state does not survive.

Face, both hands, keys and knob are legible, but the interface USB lead exits the right crop and the complete laptop endpoint is not visible. Black audio routes also cannot be traced unambiguously end to end. The reviewed simultaneous visibility of both complete cable routes and every endpoint is only partial.
